name: How long does it take to install a bidet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a bidet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a bidet varies by its type and your current plumbing setup. A standard bidet seat or attachment can often be installed within one to two hours by a professional plumber, assuming existing water lines are readily accessible. A full stand-alone bidet or an integrated bidet toilet will take longer, typically half a day or more, as it involves connecting to both hot and cold water lines and potentially modifying drainage. We schedule appointments to minimize disruption, often completing basic installations during a single visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bidet installation time depends on the bidet type; bidet seats take 1-2 hours, while stand-alone units or integrated toilets can take half a day or more.
